services.desc: Carrollwood Black Belt Academy is one of the first daycare After School Martial Arts programs established in 1999 in the Tampa Bay area. Students are escorted and transported from several elementary schools (see list below). Safety, convenience, expert training, and fun activities make Carrollwood Black Belt Academy daycare Martial Arts-School program the best martial arts school in Tampa. No need to fret if your child has a school holiday, Carrollwood Black Belt Academy Martial Arts-School program opens its door at 7:30 a.m. and parents can drop off their child(ren) at no extra cost.
